status: authored 2026-10-03; generated into the world-local pack cobblers_markets by tools/markets.py; keepers placed by tools/reapply.py R17M; NOT run in game (docs/mechanics/MARKET_GATING.md section 5 is the experiment)
owner_brief: the owner, 2026-10-03: 'I want a player to rely on money throughout the game, and to advance materially as they travel ... Backpack tiers from the Cobbleverse backpack mod, unlocked town by town so a player upgrades as they go ... Per-town stock that reads as the place - a mining town sells what a mining town would. Priced so money matters.'

mechanism.summary: a market keeper is a Cobblemon dialogue NPC beside the town's Mart: one option per shelf item, an option gated on a badge visible only to a player holding that badge (compile_dialogue 'flag' probe -> isVisible), each option running a function that re-checks the gate, reads the balance, refuses if short, charges by macro, verifies the balance fell by exactly the price, and only then gives the item as the player. The ferry's sequence (tools/ferries.py trip_lines) with the teleport replaced by a give
sources: docs/mechanics/MARKET_GATING.md sections 4-5 (the recommendation and its experiment)
tools/compile_dialogue.py: visible_when -> isVisible; the flag probe; the function effect
tools/ferries.py trip_lines: cooldown, gate re-check, balance read (EXP-040), macro charge (EXP-042 run 1), verify
experiments/EXP-022-native-dialogue-runtime/README.md bugs 1-2: give runs as the player, and the score objective exists before a store
mechanism.rung: 5 (datapack) + 7 (functions), with 2 (CobbleDollars) for the money and 4 (configuration) for the recipes; no scripting layer, no companion, no mod
mechanism.what_it_is_not: the Mart clerks (data/traders.json) are untouched: they keep the trade GUI and the ungated basics. A town gets a clerk AND a keeper

income_basis.source: docs/mechanics/PROGRESSION_LADDER.md section 0.2 (model B, the middle bracket, at cobbleDollarsIncomeMultiplier 1.25 = docs/research/INCOME_MEASUREMENT.md section 2.4 x 2.5). Not measured here: EXP-A (U-2) collapses the band
income_basis.target_source: PROGRESSION_LADDER.md section 0.3: 'cumulative spend stays near 0.65-0.70 of cumulative income at every badge. The remaining 30-35% is the Mart, the ferry, the stones and the blackout.' The blackout is a flat $600 (data/blackout.json money.charge_rule)
income_basis.counts: the critical path only (the eight gym towns and Pallet), one of each option, a pick-one group at its dearest member, stretch items excluded from the ratio and included in the hard check that a badge's cumulative ask never exceeds its cumulative income

purchase.cooldown_why: the ferry's rule (data/ferries.json trip.cooldown_why): a second submit of the same option must not pay twice. The menu closes after every purchase, so one second is ample

messages.voice: PLACEHOLDERS for Codex's voice (the keepers' greetings are on the counters). Placeholders: {item}, {price}, {count}, {requirement}, and {balance} in 'short' only
messages.gated: I only sell that to trainers with {requirement}.
messages.charge_failed: The payment didn't go through, so nothing changed hands. Check your balance and try again.
messages.give_failed: I couldn't hand that over, so your ${price} is back with you.

recipe_overlay.key_source: the shipped comment above the key: 'Disable / enable any items here (disables their recipes)'; read in sophisticatedcore-1.21.1-1.2.9.21.168.jar by ItemEnabledCondition (recipe load condition) and the creative-tab code only (docs/mechanics/TIERED_GOODS.md 2.1)
recipe_overlay.rule: every sophisticatedbackpacks item a counter sells is '|false' in the overlay, and the overlay differs from the base in nothing else; an item sold while its recipe stays on is listed in left_craftable with why

left_craftable.sophisticatedbackpacks:backpack: the first tier is leather, string and a chest: a player who can make it should, and Pallet's shelf is a kindness for the first hour, not a gate

recipe_overlay.not_run: that a disabled item's recipe is gone and the item still works when given is read from the jar, not run: audit item A-6

counters.unsited_why: Pallet is a donor town with no plan anchors (tools/town_plan.py hometown stops at KeyError 'plan'), so nothing offline can say which cell outside its Mart is open. The clerk stands inside, behind the counter (data/traders.json hometown_mart). Site it in a full checkout or by a world probe, then set status sited

keeper.greeting: First time out? Everyone leaves Pallet with a pack and a bedroll. The rest you'll buy on the road.

stock.name: Leather backpack
stock.why: tier 1 of 6: 27 slots, 1 upgrade slot. Craftable too (recipe_overlay.left_craftable)

stock.name: Sleeping bag
stock.why: passes the night and sets no spawn (comforts sleepingBagUse DAY_OR_NIGHT): the item that makes 'never build a house' literal

counters.sited_by: measured 2026-10-03: the nearest cell to the Mart clerk that tools/ambient.py's Site marks free (lots, anchors, lamps, building footprints with a 1-block margin, earthworks) on all 3x3 round it, level with its neighbours, 3.5+ blocks from every placed NPC and 3+ from every walked route line; y = the plan's ground + 1. The dressing pieces were not in that measurement (derived/signposts.json absent in the agent worktree): tools/markets.py audit checks them in a full checkout
